companyName.title: Company Name
companyName.description: The organization name displayed in the extension UI when managed by enterprise policy.

enforceSettings.title: Enforced Settings
enforceSettings.description: Settings enforced by the administrator that users cannot override.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Force a specific theme for all managed users.

analyticsEnabled.title: Analytics Enabled
analyticsEnabled.description: Enable or disable usage analytics collection.

disableFeatures.title: Disabled Features
disableFeatures.description: Array of feature identifiers to disable for managed users (e.g., 'import', 'export', 'sharing', 'offline').

allowedDomains.title: Allowed Domains
allowedDomains.description: If set, only articles from these domains can be saved. An empty array means no restriction.

blockedDomains.title: Blocked Domains
blockedDomains.description: Articles from these domains cannot be saved. Checked after allowedDomains.

supportUrl.title: Support URL
supportUrl.description: Custom support URL shown to users instead of the default support link.

defaultSettings.title: Default Settings
defaultSettings.description: Default setting values applied on first install. Users can override these unless also enforced.

hideElements.title: Hidden UI Elements
hideElements.description: Array of UI element identifiers to hide from managed users (e.g., 'upgrade-button', 'referral-section', 'analytics-dashboard').

licenseKey.title: License Key
licenseKey.description: Enterprise license key automatically applied to managed installs.

reportingEndpoint.title: Reporting Endpoint
reportingEndpoint.description: URL endpoint where usage reports and diagnostics are sent for enterprise monitoring.

updateChannel.title: Update Channel
updateChannel.description: Controls which release channel the extension follows.
